description: This Java class defines an Android activity named TranslucentBlurActivity, which demonstrates an activity with a translucent window that applies a blur effect to windows behind it. It sets up the layout and configures window flags to enable the blur effect.

classes.name: TranslucentBlurActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates translucency with a blur effect by setting window flags and layout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and enables blur behind window.
